trial.title: How the trial works
trial.body: For 21 days, you can use the features of the STUDIO plan. Work on your own or invite your team. The trial starts after you finish setting up your first business and is available once to the person paying for the subscription. Adding another business in Perelai does not start another 21 days.

capabilities.title: Included in both plans
capabilities.inbox: Requests and orders that need your attention
capabilities.booking: Public booking link — your clients choose a service and time directly on your page
capabilities.clients: Client profiles with visit history, notes and payment records
capabilities.payments: Payment records for appointments and orders
capabilities.finance: Revenue, costs and outstanding balances without a spreadsheet
capabilities.orders: Orders with payment schedules and due dates
capabilities.packages: Packages of prepaid credits that draw down as you use them
capabilities.onboarding: Niche-aware onboarding with 32 selectable business types and editable service lists
capabilities.contactImport: Contact import from your phone via vCard

billing.title: After the trial
billing.body: Each business created separately in Perelai needs its own subscription. After the trial, choose SOLO or STUDIO if you want to keep using it.
billing.renewal: Once purchased, a subscription renews monthly under the subscription terms.

faq.title: Questions about pricing and billing
faq.q1: When does the trial start, and can I get another?
faq.a1: After you finish setting up your first business. The trial is available once to the person paying for the subscription. Adding another business in Perelai does not start another 21 days.
faq.q2: What happens when the trial ends?
faq.a2: After the trial, choose SOLO or STUDIO for each business you want to keep managing in Perelai. The trial does not turn into a paid subscription automatically. Without a subscription or another valid source of access, work is restricted; trial expiry itself does not delete your data.
faq.q3: Who counts toward the service-professional limit?
faq.a3: Anyone who provides services, including a working owner and a professional without their own app login. Administrators who only manage the business do not count toward the professional limit. If they also provide services, they count toward the same limit.
faq.q4: Can I choose SOLO after the trial?
faq.a4: Yes. Before switching, keep one active service professional, remove access for other team members and cancel pending invitations. Staff records are not deleted automatically.
faq.a5: Once purchased, your subscription renews monthly. Final currency, applicable taxes and terms are shown before payment.
faq.q6: I work on my own but have an administrator helping me. Which plan should I choose?
faq.a6: Choose STUDIO if your administrator needs their own access to Perelai. They do not use a professional place unless they provide services. SOLO fits if you manage your business in Perelai yourself and one professional provides services without their own login.
faq.q7: How do I pay for several businesses?
faq.a7: Each business created separately in Perelai needs its own subscription.
